# Glenn Claes — Developer Portfolio

Personal portfolio site of Glenn Claes, a web developer based in Belgium.

## What I do

- Custom websites and web applications using Next.js, React and TypeScript
- AI features and integrations using Python
- Practical automations to save time and reduce manual work

## About

Glenn Claes is a freelance web developer based in Belgium, working across
European time zones. He specializes in building performant, accessible web
applications with modern tools including Next.js, React, TypeScript, Three.js,
Tailwind CSS, Python, and AI.

## Technical details

- Built with: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Three.js
- Deployed to: Vercel (primary), GitHub Pages (fallback)
- Languages on site: English, Dutch, German, French (client-side switcher)
